AVC-WHY-H2: Why a brand might not show up on ChatGPT
AVC-WHY-A: There isn't one cause. AI answers vary by prompt, location, account and date, and no platform can promise a mention. Common gaps we look for are a site the crawlers can't use, a thin or inconsistent brand story and competitors who are cited more often than you. The check reports what we observed, then the five fixes that matter most.
AVC-INC-BODY: What's included is an observed snapshot on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Gemini. We record the date, the mode we used and the location we tested from. You also get the five fixes that matter most, and a short report or a short recorded walkthrough plus the prompt log. We can't check every mode or every future model. What's not included is any login or account access, a guaranteed mention, citation or ranking, or a free re-check. The check uses public information only. We will not ask for passwords or account access. What we see on a public Google Business Profile is what the public sees that day. We can't see verification status or account settings. The free check is a single snapshot. Re-checks are for clients, using the same prompt set so you can compare later. If you want ongoing work on search and AI answers, the usual next step is a short, no-pressure fit call about the Authority Kit, or the Local Domination Kit for local businesses. You can also take SEO/AEO/GEO on its own.
AVC-HOW-H2: How the check works, and how long it takes
AVC-HOW-A: We send your results within 3 working days of a complete intake, if a spot is available. There are limited spots each week, so we can do each check properly. If we're full, we'll say when the next spot is free. The 3 working days start when the form is complete, not when you first click send.

AVC-HOW-VISUAL: A timeline strip: complete intake, then 3 working days, then the report or walkthrough.
AVC-WHO-BODY: It's for SMB founders and marketing leads who sell in the UK, Australia, Canada or Singapore, with a live website on their own domain, already trading. We're a particularly good fit for DTC beauty and skincare brands, for food and drink businesses in Singapore and for local businesses such as clinics, trades, studios and venues. It isn't for agencies asking on behalf of a client, for competitors, for businesses outside those four markets, for Quebec French-language brands or for businesses with no live site of their own. If it isn't a fit, we'll say so and point you to a useful guide.
